head.h1: Event Catering in Dubai for Weddings, Parties & Corporate Events

opening_paragraph: myCHEF arranges full-service event catering in Dubai from AED 120 per person for a buffet, or from AED 700 with a chef cooking and serving on site. It covers weddings, product launches, galas and milestone dinners. A vetted chef and a small brigade own the menu, the pass, the setup and the cleanup, so the host stays a guest instead of kitchen staff. Tell us the date, the guest count and the venue, and we typically reply within 15 minutes during business hours, with an itemised proposal to follow built around your evening — not a copy-paste menu. The result is food people remember, and an evening you never had to leave the room to manage.
